title.fr_fr: Lecteur de disque (données de vol traitées)

content.en_us:
How to get it :
- [[gv:machine_supercomputer|Supercomputer]] (x2) : [[gv:drive_disk_flightdata_processed|Disk Drive (Processed Flight Data)]], [[gv:drive_disk_empty|Disk Drive (Empty)]].
- [[gv:machine_supercomputer|Supercomputer]] : [[gv:drive_disk_flightdata|Disk Drive (Flight Data)]], 16000 mB Helium-4.
- [[gv:machine_supercomputer|Supercomputer]] : [[gv:drive_disk_flightdata|Disk Drive (Flight Data)]], 16000 mB Cold Perfluoromethyl.
(1 more recipes: see JEI.)

Used to make :
[[gv:missile_lambda|Lambda-98]], [[gv:launchpad_lambda|Lambda Launch Pad]].
